title: Metropolis
overview: In a towering city split between wealthy planners above and laborers toiling below, the son of the city's master falls for a woman who preaches reconciliation, while an inventor builds a robot in her likeness to incite chaos.

title: City Lights
overview: A kind-hearted tramp falls for a blind flower seller who mistakes him for a millionaire, and he schemes through a series of misadventures to raise money for an operation that could restore her sight.

title: It Happened One Night
overview: A runaway heiress escaping her father's control travels by bus to New York and strikes a deal with a cynical newspaper reporter who wants her story, and the two slowly fall for each other on the road.

title: The Wizard of Oz
overview: Swept by a tornado from a Kansas farm into a colorful magical land, a young girl follows a yellow brick road with a scarecrow, a tin man and a cowardly lion to ask a wizard to send her home.

title: Casablanca
overview: A cynical nightclub owner in wartime Morocco is torn between love and duty when his former lover arrives with her resistance-leader husband, both needing letters of transit to escape to America.

title: Bicycle Thieves
overview: In poverty-stricken postwar Rome, a father who needs his bicycle for a new job searches the city with his young son after it is stolen on his first day of work.

title: Rashomon
overview: A samurai's death in a forest is recounted by a bandit, the samurai's wife, the samurai's spirit and a woodcutter, each version contradicting the others and questioning whether truth can be known.

title: Singin' in the Rain
overview: As Hollywood switches from silent films to talkies, a leading man, his best friend and an aspiring actress conspire to rescue a troubled production whose star has a grating voice.

title: Tokyo Story
overview: An elderly couple travels to visit their grown children in the capital, only to find them too busy for them, while their widowed daughter-in-law shows them the most kindness.

title: Seven Samurai
overview: A poor farming village hires seven masterless samurai to defend its harvest from a band of raiding bandits, and the warriors train the villagers for a final desperate battle.

title: Rear Window
overview: A photographer confined to his apartment with a broken leg spies on his neighbors through the courtyard window and becomes convinced one of them has committed murder.

title: The Seventh Seal
overview: Returning from the Crusades to a land ravaged by plague, a disillusioned knight challenges Death to a game of chess to delay his fate while searching for meaning.

title: Vertigo
overview: A retired detective with a fear of heights is hired to follow an old friend's wife, becomes obsessed with her, and after tragedy strikes tries to remake another woman in her image.

title: Some Like It Hot
overview: Two jazz musicians who witness a gangland massacre disguise themselves as women and join an all-female band heading to Florida, where romance complicates their cover.

title: Psycho
overview: A secretary on the run with stolen money checks into a remote motel run by a shy young man dominated by his mother, with shocking consequences.

title: Lawrence of Arabia
overview: A British officer with an unconventional streak unites fractious Arab tribes to fight the Ottoman Empire during the First World War, crossing vast deserts as his legend grows.

title: Dr. Strangelove
overview: An unhinged general orders a nuclear strike on the Soviet Union, and politicians and generals in a war room scramble to stop the bombers before a doomsday machine is triggered.

title: 2001: A Space Odyssey
overview: From prehistoric apes to a mission to Jupiter, mysterious black monoliths guide human evolution while astronauts face a ship's computer that turns against its crew.

title: The Godfather
overview: The aging patriarch of an organized crime family transfers control of his empire to his reluctant youngest son, who is drawn ever deeper into violence to protect the family.

title: Chinatown
overview: A Los Angeles private detective hired to expose an adulterous husband uncovers a web of corruption over the city's water supply and a family's dark secret.

title: Jaws
overview: When a giant great white shark terrorizes a summer resort town, the police chief, a marine biologist and a grizzled fisherman set out to hunt it down.

title: Star Wars
overview: A farm boy joins a smuggler, a princess and an old knight to rescue the rebellion's plans from a galactic empire and destroy its planet-killing battle station.

title: Alien
overview: The crew of a commercial space freighter answers a distress signal and brings aboard a lethal creature that hunts them one by one through the ship's dark corridors.

title: Raiders of the Lost Ark
overview: An archaeologist and adventurer races rival treasure hunters across the globe to find a legendary religious artifact before it falls into the wrong hands.

title: Blade Runner
overview: In a rain-soaked future city, a weary detective hunts escaped artificial humans who have returned to Earth seeking more life from their maker.

title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
overview: A lonely suburban boy befriends a gentle alien stranded on Earth and, with his siblings, helps it evade government agents and find a way home.

title: The Terminator
overview: A relentless cyborg assassin is sent back in time to kill a waitress whose unborn son will lead humanity's resistance against machines, and a soldier follows to protect her.

title: Back to the Future
overview: A teenager accidentally travels thirty years into the past in a time-traveling car and must make sure his parents fall in love so that he will exist.

title: My Neighbor Totoro
overview: Two young sisters who move to the countryside to be near their ailing mother discover friendly forest spirits living near their new home.

title: Cinema Paradiso
overview: A famous film director returns to his Sicilian hometown for a funeral and remembers his childhood friendship with the projectionist of the village movie theater.

title: Goodfellas
overview: A young man rises through the ranks of the New York mob over three decades, enjoying the money and power until paranoia and betrayal close in.

title: The Silence of the Lambs
overview: An FBI trainee seeks help from an imprisoned, brilliant psychiatrist and cannibal to catch a serial killer who is abducting young women.

title: Jurassic Park
overview: Scientists touring an island theme park of cloned dinosaurs must survive when the security systems fail and the predators escape.

title: Schindler's List
overview: A German businessman in occupied Poland gradually turns from war profiteer to rescuer, saving more than a thousand Jewish workers from the Holocaust.

title: Pulp Fiction
overview: The lives of two hitmen, a boxer, a gangster's wife and a pair of diner robbers intertwine in a series of darkly comic, nonlinear stories of crime in Los Angeles.

title: The Shawshank Redemption
overview: A banker sentenced to life in prison for a murder he did not commit forms a lasting friendship with a fellow inmate and quietly plans his escape over two decades.

title: Toy Story
overview: A cowboy doll who is his owner's favorite toy feels threatened by a new space-ranger action figure, and the rivals must work together when they are lost outside the house.

title: Fargo
overview: A debt-ridden car salesman arranges his wife's kidnapping to extort his wealthy father-in-law, and a pregnant small-town police chief investigates the botched crime in the snowy Midwest.

title: Titanic
overview: Aboard the ill-fated ocean liner on its maiden voyage, a poor artist and an upper-class young woman fall in love as the ship strikes an iceberg and sinks.

title: The Matrix
overview: A computer hacker learns that everyday reality is a simulation built by machines to harvest humans, and joins a rebel crew fighting to free humanity.

title: Spirited Away
overview: A sullen ten-year-old girl wanders into a world of spirits, where she must work in a bathhouse for a witch to free herself and her parents, who have been turned into pigs.

title: Amélie
overview: A shy, imaginative waitress in Montmartre decides to secretly improve the lives of the people around her while struggling to pursue her own chance at love.

title: City of God
overview: A boy growing up in a violent Rio de Janeiro favela becomes a photographer, documenting the rise of drug gangs and the fates of his childhood friends.

title: Finding Nemo
overview: An overprotective clownfish crosses the ocean with a forgetful blue tang to find his son, who has been captured by a diver and placed in a dentist's aquarium.

title: Pan's Labyrinth
overview: In Francoist Spain in 1944, a girl living with her cruel stepfather, a military captain, escapes into a dark fairy-tale world where a faun sets her three dangerous tasks.

title: The Lives of Others
overview: In 1980s East Berlin, a Stasi officer assigned to spy on a playwright and his actress partner becomes increasingly absorbed in, and sympathetic to, their lives.

title: No Country for Old Men
overview: A hunter who stumbles on a drug deal gone wrong and a case of money is pursued across West Texas by a remorseless killer, while an aging sheriff tries to keep up.

title: WALL-E
overview: A lonely trash-compacting robot left to clean up an abandoned, polluted Earth falls in love with a sleek probe robot and follows her into space.

title: The Dark Knight
overview: Batman, a determined district attorney and a police lieutenant take on organized crime in Gotham until a chaotic criminal mastermind known as the Joker pushes the city to the brink.

title: Up
overview: A grieving elderly widower ties thousands of balloons to his house to fly to South America, accidentally bringing along an eager young wilderness scout.

title: Inception
overview: A thief who steals secrets from people's dreams is offered a chance at redemption if he can instead plant an idea in a target's mind through layered dream worlds.

title: A Separation
overview: When a couple in Tehran separates, the husband hires a caregiver for his father with dementia, and a confrontation with her spirals into a legal and moral dispute.

title: The Intouchables
overview: A wealthy aristocrat paralyzed after a paragliding accident hires a young man from the housing projects as his caregiver, and an unlikely friendship grows between them.

title: Gravity
overview: Two astronauts are left adrift after debris destroys their space shuttle, and a medical engineer on her first mission must find a way back to Earth alone.

title: Interstellar
overview: With crops failing on a dying Earth, a former pilot leaves his children to travel through a wormhole with a team of explorers searching for a new home for humanity.

title: Whiplash
overview: An ambitious young jazz drummer at an elite music conservatory is pushed to his limits by an abusive instructor who believes cruelty produces greatness.

title: Mad Max: Fury Road
overview: In a desert wasteland, a drifter and a rebel war-rig driver race across the desert, pursued by a tyrant and his army, to carry five women who escaped his captivity to safety.

title: Inside Out
overview: The personified emotions inside an eleven-year-old girl's mind struggle to guide her through a difficult move to a new city.

title: Arrival
overview: When mysterious spacecraft land around the world, a linguist is recruited to learn the aliens' language, and understanding it changes how she experiences time.

title: Your Name
overview: A city boy and a country girl who have never met begin swapping bodies in their sleep, and they try to find each other as a comet approaches Earth.
